requirements.general_text: Any of these: UOC Foundation in Science (Foundation): Pass with CGPA 2.50 and above. STPM (Science): A pass in STPM with at least a CGPA of 2.50. STPM (Non-Science): Pass with CGPA 2.50 with credits in 2 science subjects and Mathematics in SPM. A-Level: Pass with minimum C in 2 Science subjects and Mathematics. STAM: Pass with a minimum Jayyid grade and credits in 2 Science subjects and Mathematics at the SPM level or its equivalent. Unified Examination Certificate (UEC) (Certificate): Pass with minimum grade B in 5 subjects, including 2 Science subjects and Mathematics. Foundation from other fields/institutions (Foundation): Pass with minimum CGPA 2.50 with credits in 2 Science subjects and Mathematics at SPM level. Australian Matriculation (AUSMAT) (Matriculation): Pass with a minimum 60% points, including 2 Science subjects or credits in 2 Science subjects in SPM/O-Level or equivalent. Diploma in Traditional Complementary Medicine / other related diploma (Diploma Level): Diploma in Traditional Complementary Medicine/other related diploma: Pass with CGPA 2.50 and above; OR Pass with CGPA 2.00 with 2 years working experience in a related field. Diploma: A Diploma Kemahiran Malaysia (DKM) / Diploma Vokasional Malaysia (DVM) in T&CM-related areas or any science-related areas with at least a CGPA of 2.50 acceptable to the University. OR A DKM / DVM in T&CM-related areas or any science-related areas with CGPA above 2.00 but less than 2.50 can be accepted with a minimum of TWO years’ work experience in relevant T&CM or Science fields acceptable to the University. Canadian Pre-University/Monash University Foundation Year (MUFY)/Australian Matriculation (AUSMAT)/South Australian Matriculation (SAM) (Other): Pass with a minimum 60% points, including 2 Science subjects or credits in 2 Science subjects in SPM/O-Level or equivalent. English Proficiency (For International Students Only): MUET Band 3 or CEFR High B1 or IELTS 5.0 or TOEFL iBT 40 or equivalent.
